children.name: heading_font
children.label: Heading font (Google)
children.help_text: Pick the family and the weight (variant) used for headings.

children.name: body_font_medium
children.label: Body font medium (Google)
children.help_text: Loads the 500 weight used by buttons, labels and eyebrows. Keep the same family as the body font.

children.name: fallback
children.label: Fallback
children.help_text: Used while the secondary font loads or if it fails. The default secondary font (Tobi Pro) is a sans-serif. If a client font is set in the global Site fonts module, match this to that font.

children.name: h1_max
children.label: H1 (largest size)
children.help_text: One value for every screen. H1 scales down automatically on smaller screens: it is this size on screens 1440px wide and up and never goes below 55% of it (and never below 40px), so it never overflows on a 360px phone.

children.name: image_radius
children.label: Image radius
children.help_text: Corner radius of content images in sections (for example the Base Module image and the blog post featured image). Logos, icons, header and footer images are never rounded.

children.name: shadow
children.label: Card shadow
children.help_text: Shadow color comes from the heading color token.
